records.title: Minimum password length
records.text: Fixture control: verify the minimum length enforced for user-set passwords using admissible evidence.

records.title: Function-level authorization
records.text: Fixture control: verify function-level access is restricted to explicitly permitted consumers at a trusted boundary.

records.title: Sensitive data protection controls
records.text: Fixture control: verify sensitive data receives the protection controls defined for its protection level.

records.title: Dependency remediation time frames
records.text: Fixture control: verify components are within documented update and remediation time frames.

records.title: Third-party component inventory
records.text: Fixture control: verify an inventory such as an SBOM covers all third-party libraries and that components come from trusted, maintained repositories.

records.title: Dependency source integrity
records.text: Fixture control: verify components and their transitive dependencies resolve from the expected repository without dependency-confusion risk.
